== Summary ==
Identified: [[Matthew Reed]]. Remaining faces unlabeled.
Image for [[Matthew Reed|Matt Reed]]'s Dark Side deck Thump Droids, 1999 Young Jedi World Championship runner-up. Graphic: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999 website]] and [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].
